aka.zh: 宁德—福贡公路（2013 年规划走向）

tagline.en: From the Fujian coast to the Dulong valley behind the Gaoligong mountains, the last place in China to get a road
tagline.zh: 从福建海边到高黎贡山背后的独龙江——中国最后一个通公路的少数民族聚居区

start.en: Ningde, Fujian, on the East China Sea coast
start.zh: 福建省宁德市，东海之滨

end.en: The Dulong river valley in Gongshan county, Nujiang, Yunnan, west of the Gaoligong mountains
end.zh: 云南省怒江州贡山县独龙江河谷，高黎贡山以西

en: G353 is one of the east–west national highways added by the national highway plan of June 2013, which ran it from Ningde on the Fujian coast to Fugong in north-western Yunnan. The revised plan of July 2022 carried it on to Gongshan and names 'Gongshan (Dulongjiang)' as its last control point. Chinese Wikipedia gives its length as about 3,800 km, through seven provinces: Fujian, Jiangxi, Hubei, Hunan, Chongqing, Sichuan and Yunnan.

It is a cross-country road rather than a trunk between big cities. From Ningde it climbs inland through Zhouning, Zhenghe and Pucheng, crosses Jiangxi by Shangrao and Nanchang to Xiushui, touches Hubei at Tongcheng, crosses northern Hunan by Yueyang, Jinshi and Zhangjiajie, then runs through Laifeng and Xianfeng in Hubei and Qianjiang, Pengshui, Wulong and Wansheng in Chongqing. In Sichuan it passes Luzhou and Yibin and follows the Jinsha river upstream through Leibo, Jinyang and Huidong to Panzhihua, and in Yunnan it goes by Yongsheng, Lijiang and Weixi to Fugong and Gongshan in the Nu valley.
zh: G353 是 2013 年 6 月《国家公路网规划》增设的东西横线之一，当时自福建宁德至云南西北部的福贡。2022 年 7 月修订的规划将其延伸至贡山，最后一个主要控制点写作“贡山（独龙江）”。据中文维基百科，全长约 3800 公里，途经福建、江西、湖北、湖南、重庆、四川、云南七个省级行政区。
它不是连接大城市的干线，而是一条横穿腹地的公路。从宁德出发，经周宁、政和、浦城上山入内陆，横穿江西的上饶、南昌至修水，在通城擦过湖北，再经岳阳、津市、张家界横贯湘北，随后经湖北来凤、咸丰和重庆黔江、彭水、武隆、万盛。在四川经泸州、宜宾，沿金沙江溯流而上，过雷波、金阳、会东到攀枝花；在云南经永胜、丽江、维西，到怒江河谷的福贡和贡山。

en: The western end is the hardest ground. Dulongjiang township lies in the Dulong valley on the far side of the Gaoligong mountains, where the south-west monsoon brings rain on more than 200 days a year and 3,000 to 4,000 mm of it; from early winter until May snow up to 20 m deep closed the pass. The rebuilt Dulongjiang road, 79.982 km, runs largely on the old line but goes through the mountain in the Gaoligong Dulongjiang tunnel: 6,680 m long, 7 m wide and 4.5 m high, it bypasses 23 km of the worst old road and shortens the route by 16 km. The rest of the road is a single-lane fourth-class road, 4.5 m wide and designed for 20 km/h, fully asphalted.

In Liangshan, Sichuan, the road follows the left bank of the Jinsha river. The Shangtianba–Yanjiao section in Leibo county, about 42 km, is being rebuilt as a third-class road for 30 km/h with a new tunnel of about 3.6 km; on the 69.6 km between Dayandong and Leibo town, the 29.5 km inside the Mahu provincial geopark keep their existing formation and only the surface and roadside works are renewed. In the east the standard is higher: the 44.77 km through Tongcheng county in Hubei is being built as a class-I road for 80 km/h.
zh: 最难的是西端。独龙江乡位于高黎贡山另一侧的独龙江河谷，受印度洋西南季风影响，一年有 200 多天下雨，年降水量 3000 至 4000 毫米；每年入冬到次年 5 月，高黎贡山垭口积雪厚达 20 多米，大雪封山。改建后的独龙江公路全长 79.982 公里，大体沿老路改建，但以高黎贡山独龙江隧道穿山而过：隧道长 6680 米，净宽 7 米，净高 4.5 米，绕开老路 23 公里的“魔鬼路段”，使里程缩短 16 公里。其余路段为单车道四级公路，路基宽 4.5 米，设计时速 20 公里，满铺沥青路面。
在四川凉山，公路沿金沙江左岸走行。雷波县上田坝至岩脚段约 42 公里，按设计时速 30 公里的三级公路改建，新建约 3.6 公里的隧道；大岩洞至雷波县城的 69.6 公里中，位于马湖省级地质公园内的约 29.5 公里不拓宽路基，只改造路面和附属设施。东段标准要高得多：湖北通城境内 44.77 公里按设计时速 80 公里的一级公路建设。

en: G353 did not exist as a through route before 2013; the plan numbered a chain of existing provincial and county roads, and the provinces have been rebuilding it section by section since. Its far end has the most history. Until the late 1990s the only way into Dulongjiang township was a mule path: people had to reach the Gongshan county seat before the snows and carry in half a year's supplies, two days' walk back over the mountain. A 96.2 km road, financed by the Ministry of Transport from 1996, opened in September 1999 and ended, in People's Daily's words, the history of the last ethnic-minority area in China without a road. It was a gravel road with many temporary bridges, passable only by off-road vehicles, medium lorries and farm vehicles, and it was cut every winter.

The rebuilding began in 2010–2011: People's Daily gives October 2010, other reports and Chinese Wikipedia 29 January 2011, after approval by the National Development and Reform Commission. The road works were handed over in May 2013. The tunnel was holed through on 10 April 2014, carried emergency traffic from 20 December 2014 and opened formally on 13 November 2015, giving the Derung people a road open all year. In Yunnan's 2016 provincial road plan the Dulongjiang road was numbered S308; the 2022 national plan then made Dulongjiang the end of G353.

Further east, work is under way in several provinces at once. Hubei let the design-and-build contract for the Tongcheng section in November 2023; Jiangxi began the Luoxi (Wuning)–Huangsha (Xiushui) rebuild in 2024; Jiangjin district of Chongqing began an 18.934 km section to the Sichuan boundary on 13 August 2025, to meet a realigned section in Hejiang; and in February 2026 Chongqing approved a new 8.987 km line through Wansheng.
zh: 2013 年以前并没有一条贯通的 G353；规划把一串原有的省道、县道编为一线，此后各省分段改建。最有历史的是它的西端。直到 1990 年代末，进出独龙江乡的唯一通道是人马驿道：群众要赶在大雪封山前到贡山县城备足半年的生活物资，人背马驮走两天才能翻山回到乡里。1996 年起由交通部投资修建的独龙江公路全长 96.2 公里，1999 年 9 月建成通车，用人民网的话说，结束了我国最后一个少数民族聚居区不通公路的历史。这是一条碎石路，临时性桥涵多，只有越野车、中型卡车和农用车能勉强通行，每到冬季便中断。

改建工程于 2010—2011 年间开工：人民网记为 2010 年 10 月，另有报道和中文维基百科记为经国家发改委批准后于 2011 年 1 月 29 日开工。道路土建工程于 2013 年 5 月交工验收。隧道于 2014 年 4 月 10 日贯通，同年 12 月 20 日实现应急通车，2015 年 11 月 13 日正式通车，独龙族群众从此有了全年通行的公路。在云南省 2016 年修编的省道网规划中，独龙江公路编为 S308；2022 年的国家规划又把独龙江定为 G353 的终点。
再往东，几个省份同时在施工。湖北于 2023 年 11 月确定通城段设计施工总承包单位；江西于 2024 年开工武宁县罗溪至修水县黄沙段改建；重庆江津区 18.934 公里、止于川渝界的路段于 2025 年 8 月 13 日开工，与四川合江段改线顺接；2026 年 2 月，重庆批复了万盛城区 8.987 公里的改线工程。

en: No cost exists for G353 as a whole: it was assembled from existing roads and each section is priced and approved on its own, usually by the provincial development and reform commission. The rebuilt Dulongjiang road was put at 609 million yuan in 2014 for 79.98 km. Recent approvals range from 397 million yuan for the 69.6 km Dayandong–Leibo rebuild to 994 million for the 42 km Shangtianba–Yanjiao section, both in Liangshan, and 480 million for 9 km of new road in Wansheng, more than a third of it for land and resettlement. A single design-and-build contract for the Tongcheng section in Hubei is worth 1.002 billion yuan.
zh: G353 没有全线总造价：它由原有道路编组而成，各段分别计价、分别审批，通常由省级发改委批复。改建后的独龙江公路 79.98 公里，2014 年报道总投资 6.09 亿元。近年批复的项目中，凉山州大岩洞至雷波县城段 69.6 公里估算 3.97 亿元，上田坝至岩脚段 42 公里估算 9.94 亿元；重庆万盛新建约 9 公里估算 4.80 亿元，其中三分之一以上是土地使用及拆迁补偿费。湖北通城段一个设计施工总承包合同的中标金额就达 10.02 亿元。

en: Most of the route is ordinary two-lane road through hill country, with long stretches under reconstruction in Jiangxi, Hubei, Chongqing and Sichuan. Along the Jinsha in Liangshan the road is a narrow third-class road, and in the Mahu geopark it is designed for 20 km/h. The Dulongjiang road is single-lane, in a valley with very heavy rain, where landslides and washouts are frequent.
zh: 全线大部分是穿行丘陵山区的普通双车道公路，江西、湖北、重庆、四川都有长段正在改建。凉山境内沿金沙江的路段是较窄的三级公路，马湖地质公园内设计时速仅 20 公里。独龙江公路是单车道，河谷降雨极多，塌方、水毁频发。

why.en: No route-wide cost exists. G353 was assembled in 2013 from existing roads and is rebuilt section by section, each priced and approved separately; sourced section figures are listed below.
why.zh: 不存在全线总造价。G353 于 2013 年由原有道路编组而成，分段改建，各段单独计价、单独审批；已查到来源的路段数字分列于下。

value.en: No route-wide funding statement. The first Dulongjiang road (1996–1999) was financed by the Ministry of Transport. Recent sections combine central money with local funds: the Shangtianba–Yanjiao section applies for central vehicle-purchase-tax subsidy with the rest raised locally; the Dayandong–Leibo section is funded by Liangshan prefecture beyond any higher-level support; the Wansheng section by national subsidy and the Wansheng district budget.
value.zh: 未见全线出资说明。1996—1999 年的独龙江公路由交通部投资修建。近年各段多为中央资金加地方资金：上田坝至岩脚段拟申请中央车购税补助资金，其余由地方政府自筹；大岩洞至雷波县城段除积极争取各级支持外由凉山州自筹；万盛段为国家补助资金和万盛经开区财政预算资金。

timeline.en: The 96.2 km Dulongjiang road opens in September, the first road into Dulongjiang township.
timeline.zh: 9 月，全长 96.2 公里的独龙江公路建成通车，独龙江乡第一次通公路。

timeline.en: The rebuilding of the Dulongjiang road, with a tunnel under the Gaoligong mountains, starts on 29 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 29 日，含高黎贡山隧道的独龙江公路改建工程开工。

timeline.en: The national highway plan of June creates G353, Ningde to Fugong.
timeline.zh: 6 月，《国家公路网规划》增设 G353 宁德至福贡。

timeline.en: The Gaoligong Dulongjiang tunnel is holed through on 10 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 10 日，高黎贡山独龙江隧道贯通。

timeline.en: The tunnel opens formally on 13 November, and the Dulongjiang road becomes passable all year.
timeline.zh: 11 月 13 日，隧道正式通车，独龙江公路实现全年通行。

timeline.en: The revised national plan extends G353 to Gongshan, ending at Dulongjiang.
timeline.zh: 修订后的《国家公路网规划》将 G353 延伸至贡山（独龙江）。

timeline.en: Sichuan approves the Shangtianba–Yanjiao rebuild in Leibo; Hubei lets the Tongcheng contract in November.
timeline.zh: 四川批复雷波县上田坝至岩脚段改建工程；11 月，湖北通城段确定总承包单位。

timeline.en: Work starts on the Jiangjin section at the Sichuan–Chongqing boundary on 13 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 13 日，川渝界江津段改造工程开工。

timeline.en: Chongqing approves a new line through Wansheng in February.
timeline.zh: 2 月，重庆批复万盛城区段改建工程。
